elements.label: Hand and index finger reaching to press the lit elevator up button

sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: Sits about 0.9 s after the event at the spectrogram's right edge; a broadband vertical onset, but no visual change at that time in this packet. Classifier says whoosh, CLAP says chime; cannot separate.

pattern.description: A short live-action close-up insert: a finger moves in and presses an illuminated elevator up button, the hand's motion carrying the shot.
pattern.why_premium: A tight, shallow-depth insert of a tactile everyday action gives the narrative a concrete physical beat (calling the lift, starting the day) in well under half a second, keeping the montage pace high.

build_hint.gsap: Footage clip, no element tweens; place as a hard-cut insert on the timeline (tl.set(clip, {autoAlpha: 1})) of roughly 0.3-0.5 s; optional slow push tl.fromTo(clip, {scale: 1}, {scale: 1.05, duration: 0.5, ease: 'none'}).
build_hint.remotion: <Sequence durationInFrames={~10}> wrapping <OffthreadVideo>; optional scale interpolate(frame, [0, 12], [1, 1.05]) for a gentle push; no spring.

notes: Live-action footage. Camera verdict is none, so the 1.07 scale sum is read as in-frame content (the hand entering), not a camera move. b01 is a spurious OCR box ('2') covering the whole frame and b03/b04 are small door-frame and button-edge diffs from the hand's shadow and compression; not listed as elements.
